description: The local speech recognizer of the control panel (task 192l): whisper.cpp for Windows with CUDA and a model. The files are NOT in the repository (they are 685 MB and 488 MB); scripts/install-stt.ps1 downloads them from these addresses, checks the size and SHA256, and puts them into the tool folder (CREW_STT_DIR, by default %LOCALAPPDATA%/crew-harness/stt).
